title: 生产者-消费者：信号量模拟与 P 操作顺序颠倒导致的死锁
expected_output:
=== 正确顺序: 先 P(empty/full) 再 P(mutex) ===
  生产 item0, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item0, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 item1, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item1, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 item2, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item2, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 item3, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item3, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 4, 消费 4, 死锁=False

=== 错误顺序: 先 P(mutex) 再 P(empty/full) ===
  生产 item0, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item0, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 item1, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item1, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 item2, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item2, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 item3, 缓冲区=1/2
  消费 item3, 缓冲区=0/2
  生产 4, 消费 4, 死锁=False

铁律: 必须先 P 同步信号量（资源），再 P 互斥信号量（锁）
反例后果: 缓冲区满时生产者占着 mutex 等 empty，消费者拿不到 mutex 无法取产品 -> 死锁
code:
from collections import deque

class Semaphore:
    def __init__(self, value):
        self.value = value
        self.queue = []

    def P(self, pid):
        self.value -= 1
        if self.value < 0:
            self.queue.append(pid)
            return False        # 阻塞
        return True             # 通过

    def V(self):
        self.value += 1
        if self.value <= 0 and self.queue:
            return self.queue.pop(0)   # 唤醒一个
        return None


def run(mode, n_slots=2, n_items=4):
    """mode='correct' 先 P 同步后 P 互斥；mode='wrong' 先 P(mutex) 后 P(empty)"""
    empty = Semaphore(n_slots)
    full = Semaphore(0)
    mutex = Semaphore(1)
    buf = deque()
    produced = consumed = 0
    log = []
    steps = 0
    while consumed < n_items and steps < 200:
        steps += 1
        # --- 生产者 ---
        if produced < n_items:
            if mode == "correct":
                ok1 = empty.P("producer")       # 先等空缓冲
                ok2 = mutex.P("producer") if ok1 else False
            else:
                ok1 = mutex.P("producer")       # 先抢锁（错误顺序）
                ok2 = empty.P("producer") if ok1 else False
            if ok1 and ok2:
                buf.append("item%d" % produced)
                produced += 1
                log.append("生产 item%d, 缓冲区=%d/%d" % (produced - 1, len(buf), n_slots))
                mutex.V()
                full.V()
            else:
                log.append("生产者阻塞: empty=%d mutex=%d (等待队列=%s)"
                           % (empty.value, mutex.value, empty.queue + mutex.queue))
                if mode == "wrong":
                    return log, produced, consumed, True   # 死锁
                break
        # --- 消费者 ---
        if mode == "correct":
            ok1 = full.P("consumer")
            ok2 = mutex.P("consumer") if ok1 else False
        else:
            ok1 = mutex.P("consumer")
            ok2 = full.P("consumer") if ok1 else False
        if ok1 and ok2:
            item = buf.popleft()
            consumed += 1
            log.append("消费 %s, 缓冲区=%d/%d" % (item, len(buf), n_slots))
            mutex.V()
            empty.V()
        else:
            log.append("消费者阻塞: full=%d mutex=%d" % (full.value, mutex.value))
            if mode == "correct":
                break
    return log, produced, consumed, False


print("=== 正确顺序: 先 P(empty/full) 再 P(mutex) ===")
log, pr, co, dead = run("correct")
for l in log:
    print("  " + l)
print("  生产 %d, 消费 %d, 死锁=%s" % (pr, co, dead))

print("")
print("=== 错误顺序: 先 P(mutex) 再 P(empty/full) ===")
log2, pr2, co2, dead2 = run("wrong")
for l in log2:
    print("  " + l)
print("  生产 %d, 消费 %d, 死锁=%s" % (pr2, co2, dead2))
print("")
print("铁律: 必须先 P 同步信号量（资源），再 P 互斥信号量（锁）")
print("反例后果: 缓冲区满时生产者占着 mutex 等 empty，消费者拿不到 mutex 无法取产品 -> 死锁")
